stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja quem são os candidatos a governador, senador, deputado federal e estadual no PI

en.title: 2026 Elections: see who are the candidates for governor, senator, federal and state deputy in PI
en.summary: Voters in Piauí will cast ballots to elect a governor, two senators, 10 federal deputies, and 30 state deputies. The outlet compiled candidate information to assist voters in the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Quem são os candidatos nas eleições 2026 que acumulam multas ambientais milionárias

en.title: Who are the 2026 election candidates that accumulate million-dollar environmental fines
en.summary: Fourteen candidates in the 2026 elections hold over 100 million reais in environmental fines from federal environmental agencies accumulated over the past decade. The candidates include aspirants for state and federal deputy, Senate, and governorship positions.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: Não vai conseguir votar? Veja passo a passo para justificar seu voto

en.title: 2026 Elections: Can't vote? See step by step how to justify your vote
en.summary: Voters unable to attend the 2026 elections can justify their absence digitally through official Electoral Justice channels like the e-Título app before election day. Justifying absence is mandatory for eligible voters who do not cast ballots.

stories.title: Candidatos nas eleições 2026 somam R$ 120 milhões em multas ambientais pendentes

en.title: Candidates in 2026 elections total 120 million reais in pending environmental fines
en.summary: A survey identified 101 candidates in the 2026 general elections with environmental fines applied over the past decade, totaling approximately 120 million reais across 190 proceedings. Fines were issued by federal environmental agencies for various infractions.

stories.title: Em quem votar para deputado federal? Profissionais de diferentes áreas indicam suas escolhas

en.title: Who to vote for federal deputy? Professionals from different areas indicate their choices
en.summary: Folha de S.Paulo consulted university professors, economists, religious leaders, artists, and security experts to provide voting recommendations for undecided voters selecting federal and state deputy candidates.

stories.title: Em quem votar para deputado estadual? Profissionais de diferentes áreas indicam suas escolhas

en.title: Who to vote for state deputy? Professionals from different areas indicate their choices
en.summary: Folha de S.Paulo sought recommendations from university professors, economists, religious leaders, artists, and security experts to assist voters who have not yet decided on state and federal deputy candidates.

stories.title: Criador de Dilma Bolada nega autoria de fake news sobre Flávio e Nossa Senhora

en.title: Creator of Dilma Bolada denies authorship of fake news about Flávio and Our Lady
en.summary: Jeferson Monteiro, creator of the humor page Dilma Bolada, denied responsibility for false reports claiming Senator Flávio Bolsonaro intended to remove Nossa Senhora Aparecida's title as Brazil's Patroness.

stories.title: Após estimular fake news sobre N.S. Aparecida, coordenador da Secom invoca ‘liberdade de expressão’

en.title: After stimulating fake news about N.S. Aparecida, Secom coordinator invokes 'freedom of expression'
en.summary: A coordinator from Secom invoked freedom of expression following involvement with fake news regarding Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Trump rejeita plano iraniano para reabrir Estreito de Ormuz

en.title: Trump rejects Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Trump has rejected an Iranian proposal aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: ‘Dilma Bolada’ começou com fake sobre N. S. Aparecida, indica monitoramento da campanha de Flávio

en.title: 'Dilma Bolada' began with fake about N.S. Aparecida, indicates monitoring of Flávio's campaign
en.summary: Campaign monitoring indicates that a social media campaign known as 'Dilma Bolada' originated with false content concerning N.S. Aparecida related to Flávio's candidacy.

stories.title: Mais da metade dos candidatos de 2022 mudou de partido para as eleições de 2026

en.title: More than half of 2022 candidates changed parties for 2026 elections
en.summary: A majority of candidates who ran in 2022 switched to different political parties before the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: saiba em quantos candidatos votar e a ordem de votação

en.title: 2026 Elections: learn how many candidates to vote for and voting order
en.summary: Voters in the 2026 elections can choose up to six candidates, with different digit sequences required for each position: 4 for federal deputy, 5 for state deputy, 3 for senator, and 2 for governor and president.

stories.title: Candidatos à presidência reforçam principais plataformas em horário eleitoral

en.title: Presidential candidates reinforce main platforms during electoral broadcast time
en.summary: In the final stretch before the election, presidential candidates highlighted their key proposals during Saturday's electoral broadcast, with differing focuses on security, economic, and social policies.

stories.title: 37% avaliam o Congresso Nacional como ruim ou péssimo e 18% como ótimo ou bom, diz Datafolha

en.title: 37% rate National Congress as poor or very poor and 18% as excellent or good, says Datafolha
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows that weeks before elections, 37% of voters rate the National Congress negatively while 18% rate it positively, with 40% considering it regular.

stories.title: Irã insiste em solução diplomática após Trump rejeitar plano de paz

en.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
en.summary: Iran stated that diplomacy is the only way to resolve its conflict with the United States and Israel, following Donald Trump's rejection of an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end hostilities.

stories.title: Avaliação negativa do STF sobe para 47% e bate recorde, aponta Datafolha

en.title: Negative evaluation of Supreme Court rises to 47% and hits record, Datafolha shows
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court received its highest negative approval rating at 47%, up from 40% in May, while positive evaluation remained at 18%, according to a Datafolha poll released Saturday.

stories.title: EUA vão estabelecer padrões menos rigorosos de consumo de combustível

en.title: USA to establish less stringent fuel consumption standards
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Transportation will formalize significantly less strict vehicle fuel consumption standards through 2031 on Monday, reversing the Biden administration's push for automakers to produce more electric vehicles. President Trump stated the new standards would reduce prices for new vehicles.
